description:
Use this when the user wants the light or color of a clip or photo changed: "brighten this photo", "it's
        too dark", "make it warmer", "more punch", "black and white", "make the sky bluer". clip_id: from list_clips
        (kind photo for photos). Set values, not steps: exposure -2 to 2 (stops); brightness, contrast 0.5-1.5 and
        saturation 0-2 (1 = as is, saturation 0 = black and white); highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, tint,
        vibrance, clarity, dehaze -1 to 1; warmth -1 (cool) to 1 (warm); hue -180 to 180; sharpen, vignette, grain,
        fade 0-1 (0 = as is). One color band: color (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta) with
        color_hue, color_saturation, color_lightness -1 to 1. Guide: brighter = exposure 0.3; a dark photo = exposure
        0.5 + shadows 0.4; warmer = warmth 0.3; punchier = contrast 1.15 + vibrance 0.2; moody = contrast 1.2 +
        saturation 0.8 + vignette 0.3; vintage = fade 0.3 + grain 0.2 + warmth 0.2; bluer sky = color blue +
        color_saturation 0.3. start_seconds / end_seconds: only that part of a clip. reset=true sets light and color
        back to neutral first. The answer's notes give the look now, so "a bit more" adds to it.
        Not for: filter looks and effects (style_clip) or crop and zoom (frame_clip). Saved as an undoable version
        (undo_edit). Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then preview_frame.
name: adjust_look
title: Adjust light and color
